notes.md: - **Complaints (Lok Sabha reply, March 2026):** **2024-25** – **292** registered, **260** disposed; **2025-26** (up to February 2026) – **389** registered, **336** disposed.

- **Marthandam (Spencer Hatch, YMCA, 1921):** aimed at **five-fold development** – **physical, spiritual, mental, economic and social**; method: "**self-help with intimate expert counsel**"; villagers formed groups such as egg-selling and honey clubs.

new.s: Besides creating the Lokpal, the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013 amended which Act to provide a Directorate of Prosecution for the CBI?
new.x: The 2013 Act also amended the DSPE Act, bringing the committee to select the CBI Director and a Directorate of Prosecution.
new.angle: U0349 notes gap: Lokpal Act 2013 amended the DSPE Act

new.s: At least what share of the members of the Lokpal must be from the SCs, STs, OBCs, minorities and women?
new.x: At least 50% of Lokpal members must be from SC, ST, OBC, minorities and women; separately, 50% must be judicial members.
new.angle: U0349 notes gap: Lokpal 50% SC/ST/OBC/minorities/women

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the composition of the Lokpal:
1. Half of its members must be judicial members.
2. At least half of its members must be from the SCs, STs, OBCs, minorities and women.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both rules apply together: 50% judicial members and at least 50% from SC, ST, OBC, minorities and women.
new.angle: U0349 notes gap: Lokpal judicial share and reservation together

new.s: Which body reiterated the recommendation for a Lokpal in 2007?
new.x: The Second ARC (2007) reiterated the Lokpal; the First ARC (1966) had first recommended it.
new.angle: U0349 notes gap: Second ARC reiterated the Lokpal

new.s: Who was the co-chairman of the Joint Drafting Committee on the Lokpal Bill set up in April 2011?
new.x: The Joint Drafting Committee (April 2011) was chaired by Pranab Mukherjee with Shanti Bhushan as co-chairman.
new.angle: U0349 notes gap: Joint Drafting Committee co-chair Shanti Bhushan

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Lokayukta of Andhra Pradesh:
1. The Chief Minister comes within its ambit.
2. MLAs come within its ambit.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The AP Lokayukta and Upa-Lokayukta Act, 1983 covers both the Chief Minister and the MLAs.
new.angle: U0349 notes gap: AP Lokayukta covers CM and MLAs

new.s: Which Supreme Court case directed that the Central Vigilance Commission be given statutory status?
o: Vineet Narain v Union of India
Kesavananda Bharati v State of Kerala
S.R. Bommai v Union of India
Indra Sawhney v Union of India
new.x: The Vineet Narain case (1997) directed statutory status for the CVC, which came with the CVC Act, 2003.
new.angle: U0349 notes gap: Vineet Narain case -> CVC statutory status

new.s: According to the Union Government's reply in the Lok Sabha (March 2026), how many complaints did the Lokpal register in 2024-25?
new.x: The Lokpal registered 292 complaints in 2024-25 and disposed of 260 of them.
new.angle: U0349 web: #4/#22 Lokpal working -> complaints received

new.s:
Consider the following statements about complaints to the Lokpal:
1. The Lokpal registered 292 complaints in 2024-25.
2. Complaints registered in 2025-26 (up to February 2026) were fewer than in 2024-25.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: 292 complaints were registered in 2024-25; 389 were registered in 2025-26 up to February 2026, so complaints rose.
new.angle: U0349 web: #22 Lokpal working -> complaint trend

new.s: Under Section 7 of the RTI Act, which applicants are not charged any fee for information?
new.x: Section 7 of the RTI Act says no fee is charged from persons below the poverty line.
new.angle: U0350 notes gap: RTI Section 7 free for BPL

new.s: The 2021 change allowing tenure extension one year at a time up to five years applies to the CBI Director and which other office?
o: Director of Prosecution of the CBI
new.x: Since 2021 both the CBI Director and the ED Director can get one-year extensions up to five years in all.
new.angle: U0350 notes gap: ED Director tenure same as CBI Director

new.s: Who appoints the Director of the CBI?
new.x: The Central Government appoints the CBI Director on the recommendation of a committee of the PM, LoP and CJI (or his nominee).
new.angle: U0350 notes gap: CBI Director appointed by the Central Government

new.s: With which organisation did NITI Aayog bring out the India Electric Mobility Index?
new.x: NITI Aayog prepares the India Electric Mobility Index with WRI India; the EPI is with the Institute for Competitiveness.
new.angle: U0351 notes gap: India Electric Mobility Index with WRI India

new.s: In NITI Aayog's SDG India Index, Andhra Pradesh ranked first in which Goal?
new.x: Andhra Pradesh is 1st in SDG 7 and 2nd in SDG 14.
new.angle: U0351 notes gap: AP 1st in SDG 7

new.s: What rank does the Vice-Chairperson of NITI Aayog hold?
o: Secretary to the Government of India
new.x: The Vice-Chairperson, the executive head of NITI Aayog, holds Cabinet rank; full-time members hold MoS rank.
new.angle: U0351 notes gap: NITI Vice-Chairperson Cabinet rank

new.s: What weight does the Health and Nutrition theme carry under the Aspirational Districts Programme?
new.x: Health and Nutrition carries 30%; Agriculture and Water Resources 20%; Financial Inclusion and Basic Infrastructure 10% each.
new.angle: U0351 notes gap: ADP Health and Nutrition 30%

new.s: What is the Centre-State funding ratio for general States under the revamped Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan?
new.x: RGSA is funded 60:40 by the Centre and States; North-Eastern and hill States get 90:10.
new.angle: U0353 notes gap: RGSA funding 60:40

new.s: From which year has the Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan, which trains PRI members, been implemented?
new.x: RGSA runs from 2018-19; it was revamped for 1 April 2022 to 31 March 2026.
new.angle: U0353 notes gap: RGSA from 2018-19

new.s: Which Viceroy's resolution provided for elected non-official majorities and non-official chairmen in local boards?
new.x: Lord Ripon's resolution of 18 May 1882 provided elected non-official majorities and non-official chairmen.
new.angle: U0353 notes gap: Ripon 1882 non-official majorities

new.s: Which committee recommended a Minister for Panchayati Raj in the State Council of Ministers?
new.x: The Ashok Mehta Committee (1978) recommended a Minister for Panchayati Raj in the State cabinet.
new.angle: U0354 notes gap: Ashok Mehta -> Minister for Panchayati Raj

new.s: Which of the following was NOT a recommendation of the Ashok Mehta Committee?
o: A Minister for Panchayati Raj in the State cabinet
The District Collector as chairman of the Zila Parishad
new.x: Collector as Zila Parishad chairman was Balwant Rai Mehta's idea; Ashok Mehta reduced the Collector's role.

new.s: Which committee recommended direct elections at all levels of Panchayati Raj and served as the model for the 64th Amendment Bill?
new.x: The Congress party's Gadgil Committee (1988) recommended direct elections at all levels and was the model for the 64th Bill.
new.angle: U0354 notes gap: Gadgil -> direct elections at all levels

new.s: With whom did Rabindranath Tagore start the Sriniketan rural reconstruction work in 1921?
new.x: Tagore began the Sriniketan experiment in Bengal in 1921 with Leonard Elmhirst.
